note: All forced paths warm before auto tuning. Result medians use seven interleaved rounds, self-warm calls and adaptive batches targeting 0.5 ms (1..32 calls). Timings and autotuning both include activation quantization and reconstruction where applicable. Auto also has a paired ABBA comparison against its exact selected forced kernel. Logical code GB/s is tensor bytes/time, not measured HBM bandwidth. Independent scalar checks are in behemoth_gpu_tests.
